---
title: "Figures"
engine: pari-gp
format: html
---

A plot exported as SVG becomes a figure:

```{gp}
#| fig-cap: "The sine wave"
#| fig-alt: "A sine wave between -3 and 3"
plothexport("svg", X = -3, 3, sin(X))
```

With a label it can be cross-referenced, as in @fig-zeta:

```{gp}
#| label: fig-zeta
#| fig-cap: "Real part of zeta on the critical line"
print(plothexport("svg", T = 0, 40, real(zeta(1/2 + I*T))))
```

Ordinary output is still a code block:

```{gp}
6 * 7
```
